jobs.title: Senior Delivery Project Manager (FD7F5F9)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a financial planning technology company that builds a verifiable financial advice engine for banks, credit unions, broker-dealers, independent advisors and insurance companies across Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom. Founded in 2018, it powers financial planning at scale, with team members distributed across three countries.

You would be the single accountable owner of project delivery. You take a project from the moment scope is handed off through to production, closure and retrospective — answerable for how it runs, how it is governed, how it is reported and when it deploys for the client. You set the direction for each project: defining how it will be governed, converting high-level scope from the sales engineering and solutions consulting teams into a client-facing Statement of Work, calling for the solutioning resources the work demands, and driving milestones and dependencies to closure. You own the truth of status, internally and externally, and when a project is at risk you own the recovery plan, not just the escalation.

The Role

Run multiple concurrent projects across client delivery engagements, applying best practices in project governance and change management.
Own each project end to end, from initiation to production and closure.
Author Statements of Work that define deliverables, milestones, timelines, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions, acceptance criteria and client responsibilities precisely enough to hold up through delivery.
Hold internal and external stakeholders to commitments, raising risks and blockers early and owning mitigation before they affect commitments.
Track program planning, status and reporting in JIRA and Confluence.

What We're Looking For

5-10 years of project management experience.
Demonstrated ownership of complex delivery projects end to end in a client-facing environment.
Proven ability to author project charters, Statements of Work and executive-level status reporting.
A highly organized, detail-oriented approach, with the judgment to be trusted to make decisions.

This is a remote role for candidates in Canada or the United States. It could suit a delivery or project manager who has owned client-facing technology implementations and wants genuine accountability for how projects land — not just coordination of them.

jobs.title: Payroll Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

SD Guthrie Berhad (SD Guthrie)
is one of the world’s leading producers of Certified Sustainable Palm Oil (CSPO), representing approximately 12% of the global market share (as of 31 December 2022). With over 84,000 employees across 12 countries, we pride ourselves on innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Our operations span the entire palm oil value chain, and we are expanding into new business verticals such as green industrial parks and renewable energy. We offer enriching career opportunities supported by cutting-edge technology and a commitment to sustainability. We are the world’s first palm oil company to have our net-zero GHG emissions reduction targets approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).

Join us today, as we continue to Unlock Nature's Superpowers.

Your Mission

Implementation Planning and Coordination

Develop and maintain detailed country and workstream implementation plans aligned with the overall programme timeline.
Coordinate implementation activities across HR, Payroll, Finance, Group IT, country teams, implementation partners and payroll service providers.
Define and monitor key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resource requirements and critical-path activities.
Ensure that roles, responsibilities, expected outputs and due dates are clearly communicated to all relevant parties.
Coordinate the sequencing of activities across SAP Payroll migration, Workday integration, payroll service transition and change management workstreams.
Identify schedule conflicts, resource constraints and cross-workstream dependencies, and escalate them promptly.
Maintain implementation momentum by following up on outstanding actions and ensuring timely closure.

Discovery and Blueprint

Coordinate country kick-off, discovery, requirements-gathering and Blueprint sessions.
Ensure that the appropriate country and functional representatives participate in relevant workshops.
Track the collection, review and approval of country payroll requirements, statutory requirements, process information and supporting documentation.
Coordinate the review and closure of gaps, assumptions, decisions and action items identified during discovery and Blueprint.
Ensure that approved requirements and decisions are reflected in the implementation plan and relevant project deliverables.
Work with the Payroll Project Technical Lead to ensure that technical dependencies and solution decisions are incorporated into country rollout plans.

Configuration, Integration and Data Readiness

Coordinate configuration, integration and data-preparation activities across internal teams and implementation partners.
Track completion of data templates, data cleansing, mapping, validation and migration-readiness activities.
Monitor the delivery and review of functional and technical specifications.
Coordinate the resolution of business, process and data-related issues that may affect implementation readiness.
Ensure that configuration and integration dependencies are reflected in the project schedule.
Escalate unresolved issues that may affect scope, timeline, payroll accuracy or country readiness.

Testing and Parallel Runs

Develop and coordinate the overall testing schedule covering unit testing, System Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing and payroll parallel runs.
Ensure that test scope, scenarios, participants, environments, data, entry criteria and exit criteria are defined before each test phase.
Coordinate country HR, payroll users, Finance, IT teams and vendors during testing and parallel-run activities.
Monitor test execution, defects, retesting, outstanding issues and closure status.
Ensure that testing evidence, reconciliation results, approvals and sign-offs are properly documented.
Coordinate the review of payroll results, reports, payslips, interfaces and downstream outputs with the relevant business and technical teams.
Track readiness against agreed testing and parallel-run acceptance criteria.
Escalate material defects or unresolved gaps that may affect cutover or the Go/No-Go decision.

Cutover, Go-Live and Stabilisation

Develop and maintain the integrated business and operational cutover plan.
Coordinate cutover tasks, owners, dependencies, timings, checkpoints and readiness evidence.
Ensure that business, system, data, support and communication readiness requirements are completed before go-live.
Coordinate cutover rehearsals and track the closure of identified gaps.
Consolidate country and workstream readiness status to support the Go/No-Go decision.
Coordinate implementation activities during go-live and ensure that issues are assigned, prioritised and resolved promptly.
Monitor hypercare and stabilisation activities, including incident trends, outstanding defects and operational handover.
Ensure that exit criteria for hypercare and transition to business-as-usual support are defined and achieved.

Vendor and Stakeholder Management

Manage day-to-day delivery coordination with implementation partners, payroll service providers and other third parties.
Monitor vendor deliverables against agreed scope, quality, schedule and acceptance criteria.
Facilitate regular implementation status reviews and ensure that decisions and action items are documented.
Work with country leads and functional stakeholders to resolve delivery issues and maintain alignment.
Escalate significant vendor-performance, timeline, resource or quality concerns to the Global Payroll Project Manager.
Build effective working relationships across countries, functions and vendor teams.

Governance, Reporting and Documentation

Maintain accurate implementation status, action, risk, issue, dependency and decision records.
Provide consolidated implementation updates for project governance and management reporting.
Ensure that project documentation, approvals, evidence and sign-offs are complete and properly stored.
Support preparation for PMO, Steering Committee and management review meetings.
Monitor compliance with agreed project governance, change-control and escalation procedures.
Ensure that country implementation activities remain aligned with approved scope, timeline and project standards.

Decision-Making and Accountability

Accountable for the timely and coordinated execution of country and workstream implementation activities.
Makes day-to-day implementation and scheduling decisions within the approved project scope, plan and governance framework.
Recommends corrective actions, recovery plans and implementation priorities when delivery deviations occur.
Escalates matters involving material scope, cost, timeline, technical, regulatory or business impact to the Global Payroll Project Manager.
Does not hold final approval authority for budget, major scope changes, technical design or Go/No-Go decisions.
Works with the Payroll Project Technical Lead on technical matters and with business owners on payroll-process and operational approvals.

Ideal Candidate

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Information Technology, Project Management or a related discipline.
At least five years of relevant experience in payroll, HR technology or enterprise-system implementation.
Demonstrated experience managing at least two full-cycle payroll, Workday, SAP or HR transformation implementations.
Experience managing multi-country or regional implementations involving multiple business units and stakeholder groups.
Strong understanding of payroll implementation phases, including discovery, Blueprint, configuration, data migration, testing, parallel runs, cutover, go-live and stabilisation.
Experience coordinating System Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing and payroll parallel runs.
Good working knowledge of SAP Payroll, Workday integrations and third-party payroll service models.
Strong project planning, implementation management, risk management and problem-solving capabilities.
Proven experience managing implementation partners, vendors and cross-functional teams.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, dependencies and deadlines in a complex programme environment.
Strong stakeholder-management, facilitation, negotiation and communication skills.
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate implementation plans, status reports and governance records.
Experience with Microsoft Project, Microsoft Planner or similar project-management tools would be an advantage.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or other relevant project-management certification would be an advantage.
Experience in payroll transformation within a large multinational organisation would be an advantage.

Why Join Us?

Hybrid Workplace
Learning on Demand
Employee Wellness Programme
Employee Engagement Activities
Fully Subsidised Sports Clubs
Education Assistance (terms & conditions apply)
Free Parking
Free Shuttle Service from nearest LRT
and many more...

jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager

We are Acrylicize, a global creative studio powered by art and culture, inspired by stories of people and place. Our multidisciplinary team of artists, designers, project managers, and strategists, create and curate art that activates spaces for some of the world’s leading brands and institutions. Experts in using art and design to drive positive change for people and planet, delivering unmissable moments that get everyone talking. With studios in New York and London, we offer creative impact on a global scale.

As a Senior Project Manager you will play a pivotal role in the studio, looking after our clients and the logistics of our exciting projects from initial briefing through to installation and aftercare. You will be an integral part of the Projects Team and work closely with the New Business Team, Creative Director, CEO and wider studio to help ensure projects are delivered smoothly, on time, and to a high standard.

This is a hands-on leadership role, ideal for an experienced Project Manager who enjoys taking ownership of complex creative projects while collaborating closely with clients, designers, suppliers and the wider studio.

Main Responsibilities

Client & Stakeholder Management

● Act as the primary point of contact for clients from initial briefing through to installation and aftercare.

● Build strong client relationships through clear communication and proactive project management.

● Lead client meetings, manage expectations, and provide regular project updates.

● Coordinate communication between clients, suppliers, contractors, and the internal team.

Project Delivery

● Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest standard.

● Develop and manage project programmes, milestones and delivery plans.

● Identify project risks and resolve issues proactively.

● Coordinate site visits, installations, snagging and project close-out.

Commercial & Resource Management

● Prepare project estimates, quotations, fee proposals, and manage project budgets.

● Negotiate supplier pricing and oversee procurement to achieve best value.

● Work with the Projects Director to allocate resources and manage team workload.

● Monitor project financial performance and provide regular updates to senior leadership.

Creative Collaboration & Technical Delivery

● Partner with Designers to ensure creative concepts are deliverable within programme and budget.

● Advise on materials, fabrication methods, production techniques, and installation approaches.

● Source materials, products, suppliers, and specialist contractors.

● Support continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, improving processes, and mentoring junior team members.

Skills & Experience

● An education in the design field

● Proven experience delivering projects in the design industry at a range of scales and across multiple disciplines

● Experience handling accounts and dealing directly with clients

● Prior project management related experience is preferable

● Experience working with relatively large production budgets up to £500,000

● Excellent organisational skills

● Fantastic written and verbal communication skills

● A passion for quality in every endeavour

● A hunger to constantly improve the studio’s output

● A good knowledge of InDesign

● Working knowledge of CAD software

A little bit about our benefits...

● Hybrid working (Tuesday–Thursday in the studio, Monday and Friday optional from home)

● Enhanced maternity and paternity leave

● AXA Employee Assistance Programme from day one

● Medicash healthcare cash plan

● L&G Life Assurance

● Cycle to Work scheme

● Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme

● YellowNest Childcare salary sacrifice scheme

● Half a day each month for creative pursuits, plus a £15 monthly allowance

● Company MacBook

● Regular team lunches and social events

Acrylicize is proud to be a certified B Corporation, reflecting our commitment to using business as a force for good. This certification underscores our dedication to balancing profit with purpose, ensuring that our decisions positively impact our employees, clients, communities, and the environment. We’re seeking passionate individuals who not only excel in their craft but also deeply believe in the values of sustainability, social responsibility, and community. If you’re inspired by the opportunity to make a meaningful difference through your work, we’d love to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, disability, national origin, gender and gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, veteran status or pregnancy or maternity.

Take our vision into the future.

The AtkinsRéalis Infrastructure Project Delivery Practice (PDP) is the centre of excellence for the delivery of infrastructure projects and combines the best in project management and design management to provide a full suite of services to clients in the public and private sectors.

We have several exciting vacancies for talented Project Managers to join our teams across the UK in our expanding Defence Infrastructure market.

The infrastructure business is responsible for delivery of design services across our markets of Defence Infrastructure, Water Infrastructure, Nuclear, Aviation, Energy, Rail, and Urban Developments. We have an exciting vacancy within the Infrastructure PDP and are seeking an enthusiastic, pro-active and confident Project Manager to join our Epsom and South-East practice, based in our Epsom office. You will be a Project Manager within the infrastructure sector; this role offers the chance to develop your career and expand your experiences across a wide range of challenging and exciting projects. The position is likely to combine agile working from our Epsom office with time at client offices and sites. The individual will be responsible for delivery of multi-disciplinary projects from concept through to construction. You will be responsible for delivering schemes to budget and programme through RIBA Stages 0-7 (or the sector equivalent) and have stakeholder liaison with our clients on our expanding portfolio of the biggest and most challenging projects across the Defence market. This is a great opportunity for you to work and develop within an internationally renowned consultancy, working on a variety of projects where your talent and skills can be demonstrated.

Primary Location – Epsom, Surrey, United Kingdom.

Your role

Delivery of project management and contract administration through the project life cycle.
Ensuring that there is a common understanding of requirements and scope, programme, costs, constraints, risk and interfaces across the team. The successful delivery of the project to meet targets, e.g. programme, budget, and quality.
Identifying and agreeing project objectivities with the Project Director and developing a strategy for achieving these.
Identifying, escalating, and managing any matters that could pose a potential contractual/commercial risk to AtkinsRéalis.
A member of the project team – building, motivating, maintaining, coaching, guiding, and developing the team. Communicating, liaising, and engaging with clients on a project-by-project basis.

Management of Risk, Opportunity and mitigation measure for the project. Administer and negotiate change control from inception through to completion.
Clear and accurate monitoring and reporting of project performance against programme, technical quality, financial and KPI targets; both internally and externally.
Cognisant delivery of projects and tasks in accordance with the AtkinsRéalis Values; Safety, Integrity, Collaboration and Innovation.

A Project Management/Engineering/Building Surveying/Architectural background, with design management, project management and contract administration experience.
Chartered with the APM or equivalent professional Engineering qualification / chartership.
A hard working and flexible individual, who is a team player, possesses great attention to detail, is reliable, proactive and demonstrates initiative.
Excellent interpersonal, organisational and communication skills both verbal and written.
Ability to manage and motivate a team and demonstrate good leadership qualities.
Customer focused with excellent client relationship management skills. Experience across a range of construction projects and Markets particularly Defence.
Experience of leading the management of projects from inception to completion (RIBA Stages 0 – 7 or equivalent).
Has and clear understanding and experience of construction contracts, particularly NEC3.
Experienced at preparing Scope Definition papers, Project Execution Plans, Risk Registers, Change Control Logs and Client & Stakeholder Management plans.
Experience of managing design projects to time, cost and quality objectives and familiar with programming and earned value techniques.
Self-motivated and able to work both within a larger multi-discipline team.
Familiar with the application BIM modelling tools for design and coordination purposes.
A supportive and encouraging approach to mentoring members of the team.
Ability to adapt to different working environments to build rapport with clients. Be available to travel across the UK and work away from home, when required.
Holds a valid UK driving licence and able to travel to sites across the United Kingdom. Already holds or would be willing to undertake UK Security clearance. (if applicable for a project.

About Us

Our mission is to provide transparency on business conduct risks to drive positive change. Combining advanced AI with deep human expertise, and a proven methodology at the core, RepRisk’s solutions bring performance and peace of mind, enabling clients to know more, be sure, and act faster. With our values of intellectual honesty and humility, operational excellence, and openness and respect, our diverse teams of talented experts are pioneering solutions that enable clients to make better informed decisions. Headquartered in Zurich, and with offices in Toronto, New York, London, Berlin, Manila, and Tokyo, we stay close to clients and bring an independent lens to the industry. United by our shared belief in the power of data, our 400 people are proud to be setting the global standard for business conduct data and driving positive and meaningful change through transparency.

We Offer

A diverse, multicultural, collaborative and dynamic work environment in our fast-paced, mission-driven company.
Our working conditions support a good work-life balance. This includes the opportunity to work flexibly and from home (up to 3 days per week possible).
You will have market-based compensation, benefits and perks in line with our culture and values.
Paid volunteering and training days, plus a donation matching program and a health and fitness subsidy.
Frequent (optional) social events: From office parties to cultural potlucks or team sports - and much more!
At RepRisk we respect the different needs and life experiences of our colleagues and we value diversity. Equal opportunities and equal treatment are a top priority.
And more!

Job Description

The Role

Are you looking for a role where you can bring structure to complexity, turn strategic priorities into action, and help shape the future of Data, Product and Technology? Would you enjoy working at the intersection of business operations, governance, and cross-functional delivery in a growing global company?

Your Impact

Do you want your work to have a visible, measurable impact? In this role, you will strengthen how strategic initiatives are governed and delivered, align teams and priorities, enable effective decision-making, and ensure clear communication and follow-through across the organization.

What You Bring

Are you a proactive, highly organized program manager who brings people together and turns ambiguity into coordinated action? Do you communicate with clarity, take ownership, adapt confidently to changing priorities, and maintain a strong focus on quality and deadlines? If your answers are YES, this could be the perfect role for you!

Your Responsibilities

Data Operations

Support strategic and operational planning, prioritization, and execution across data operations.

Coordinate cross-functional activities, dependencies, risks, and follow-up to maintain delivery momentum.

Develop clear plans, progress updates, and decision materials that promote transparency and continuous improvement.

Data Governance

jobs.title: NATO ON-X Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a Program Manager (PM) to lead the capture-to-delivery transition and, upon award, to serve as the single point of accountability for program performance, cost, schedule, and customer satisfaction across a large, multi-year program to extend the existing Operational Network into a classified private multi-cloud capability (“ON-X”). The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) procurement is structured as a ten-year Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) framework, through firm-fixed-price (FFP) Task Orders drawn from a Contractor-built Service Catalogue. Early Task Orders are expected to cover network takeover and transition planning, discovery and target-architecture design, and a Proof-of-Concept gate, followed by a hybrid mix of one-time delivery and steady-state managed-service outcomes spanning cloud platform engineering, identity and data services, AI platform services, secure access, digital workplace, cyber resilience, accreditation, and sovereignty assurance.

The PM will own end-to-end delivery of the ON-X contract: integrating cost, schedule, and technical performance across a portfolio of firm-fixed-price Task Orders; managing the transition from the incumbent NATO-operated model to a Contractor-operated model; and building the governance, financial management, and risk-management rigor required to sustain a decade-long IDIQ relationship with a demanding, security-conscious international customer. The PM will be the primary customer-facing interface with the NCIA and will direct a multi-disciplinary team spanning cloud engineering, security accreditation, service management, and subcontractor/partner organizations.

Responsibilities

Serve as the single point of accountability for overall program performance, cost, and schedule across all active Task Orders issued under the ON-X IDIQ.
Plan, staff, and mobilize the program at contract start, including stand-up of the Project Management Office (PMO), integrated master schedule, and Purchaser-approved governance rhythm.
Own Task Order-level and program-level financial management: budgeting, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete, invoicing, and firm-fixed-price margin performance; apply FinOps discipline to cloud consumption and cost transparency obligations.
Lead the takeover and transition of ON operations from the incumbent NATO-operated model, ensuring service-level continuity against the pre-handover baseline and demonstrable absorption of operational knowledge.
Direct discovery, target-architecture design, and Proof-of-Concept execution, coordinating cross-functional teams (cloud/platform engineering, identity and data services, security and accreditation, service management) against Purchaser-approved gate criteria.
Maintain traceability across Outcomes (HLOs), Implementation Requirements, the QASP, CDRL, Service Catalogue, and Task Orders, ensuring the program's delivery evidence stays audit ready.
Own program risk management, including risks related to migration/cutover, accreditation and Authority to Operate timelines, sovereignty and jurisdictional-control obligations, and supply-chain/4th-party dependencies.
Manage subcontractors and technology partners supporting the multi-cloud platform, ensuring performance, security, and compliance obligations flow down and are enforced.
Act as the primary interface with the NCIA customer and NATO stakeholders for contract performance, escalations, and Award Fee/performance reviews; support Purchaser governance boards and quarterly reviews.
Ensure compliance with applicable NATO security policy (including cloud-specific NATO SECRET directives), export control, and Leidos corporate contract-management standards.
Report program status, financials, and risk to Leidos executive leadership and to the customer on an agreed cadence; prepare and present Integrated Program Baseline / resource-loaded schedule updates.
Support proposal-to-execution continuity by contributing PM-domain input during remaining capture and Step 2 proposal activities, and by owning post-award transition-in planning.
Mentor and develop program leadership and task leads; build a high-performing, security-cleared workforce able to sustain a ten-year program.

Required Qualifications Are As Follows

Bachelors in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related discipline and 15+ years or more of experience; Masters and 12+ years or more of experience.
10+ years of program management experience managing large scale firm-fixed-price (FFP) contracts or Task Orders in a complex technical environment, including cost, schedule, and technical-performance accountability.
5+ years of experience with Information and Computer Technologies (ICT) procurement, implementation, migration and management.
Demonstrated experience managing IT infrastructure, managed-services, or systems-integration programs of comparable scale and complexity.
Proven experience serving as the primary customer-facing interface on programs involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete, and variance analysis on fixed-price programs.
Experience managing program risk, subcontractors, and cross-functional/matrixed teams
Excellent executive-level written and verbal communication skills.
Project Management certifications (e.g. PRINCE2 Agile Practitioner, Project Management Institute (PMI) Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent) and valid Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation Certificate at minimum
Must have a current active NATO Secret level security clearance.
High ability in speaking, writing, and understanding English is essential as all on-site work will be conducted in English. Minimum required level of English language of SLP3333 as defined in NATO STANAG 6001.

Desired Skills Are As Follows

Experience managing cloud infrastructure, cloud migration, or multi-cloud platform programs (IaaS/PaaS, DevSecOps pipelines, identity and data services, or secure cloud access) is highly desired.
Prior experience supporting NATO, NCIA, a NATO Nation Ministry of Defense, or another international/coalition organization is desired.
Experience with security accreditation processes (Authority to Operate, continuous compliance) in a classified or high-assurance environment.
Familiarity with FinOps practices, cloud cost transparency/chargeback models, and cloud cost-management tooling.
Experience with large-scale network or data-center takeover/transition-in from an incumbent operator, including operational knowledge transfer.
Additional relevant certifications such as SAFe Agile, CISSP/CISM, an AWS/Azure/Google Cloud certification.
Experience operating in a multinational, geographically distributed team environment, including coordination across allied or coalition partners.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Fives Intralogistics Corp. is seeking a proactive Project Manager
to lead Services projects from sales handover through project closeout, with a focus on large retrofit and modernization projects, including multi-site customer projects. Reporting to the Senior Project Portfolio Manager, this role serves as the primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders and acts as a liaison between Sales, Engineering, Controls, Procurement, Field Service, Site Management, and project execution teams.

This position is responsible for initiating, planning, coordinating, scheduling, executing, controlling, and closing Retrofit and Services projects of moderate to large scope, including complex, multi-site retrofit projects. The Project Manager is accountable for project financial performance, cost management, contract administration, customer communication, deliverables, and stakeholder relationships while ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, at or below budget, and with high customer satisfaction.

This role supports consistent customer experience and project performance across assigned Services initiatives by applying Fives Intralogistics project management processes, product knowledge, system understanding, and cross-functional coordination. The Project Manager contributes to successful execution of large-scale retrofit and modernization projects by maintaining schedule discipline, financial visibility, risk management, and clear communication across multiple concurrent customer sites.

Character Qualifications

Integrity
– Is open, honest, and committed to giving the straight story every time.

Ownership
– Takes full, personal, individual, responsibility for their actions and work.

Innovation
– Creates a culture of relentless improvement of products and processes to make every day better.

Service
– Serves our clients, families, communities, and most of all, our people who are empowered to and safe in making decisions and taking actions that dare to make us better.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Lead assigned Services projects from initiation through closeout, owning schedule, budget, risk, documentation, customer communication, and execution outcomes for retrofit, modernization, and multi-site customer projects while managing day-to-day coordination between cross-functional teams, vendors, subcontractors, and stakeholders. Responsible for the following:

GENERAL DUTIES

Integrated Schedule Management: Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and execution plans for assigned projects, including multi-site retrofit projects; establish and maintain schedule baselines at project handover to define the approved execution plan.
Project Execution: Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling, and closeout; adjust plans as needed to maintain schedule performance, manage risk, and support successful delivery across single-site and multi-site project scopes.
Resource Coordination: Coordinate internal and external resources required for project execution, including Engineering, Controls, Procurement, Field Service, Site Management, vendors, and subcontractors; work with resource leaders to secure appropriate staffing and balance competing priorities across multiple concurrent sites or projects.
Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders throughout project execution; build and maintain strong customer relationships, manage expectations, and facilitate resolution of concerns and project issues across assigned project sites.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate project documentation and records within company systems; provide regular status updates and executive-level project health reports to customers and leadership.
Financial Management: Manage project budgets, forecasts, and profitability; track and report financial performance including revenue, cost, margin, change orders, and financial risks; initiate corrective actions as needed for complex retrofit and multi-site customer projects.
Team Presence: Facilitate project kickoff meetings and ongoing project review meetings and visit project sites as required to support field execution and customer relationships.
Risk, Scope & Closeout: Identify project risks and mitigation plans; manage scope changes and change order processes; ensure contractual deliverables are completed; facilitate financial closeout; and support transition to warranty or ongoing service support activities for assigned retrofit and multi-site customer project work.
Core Values: Uphold Fives Intralogistics’ character qualifications Integrity, Ownership, Innovation, and Service in all project interactions, championing safety performance and customer satisfaction as measures of project success.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and the requirements for the performance of this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

Qualifications

Qualified candidates must have a proven track record of managing customer-facing projects with strong ownership, organization, communication, financial discipline, and the ability to coordinate complex work across multiple stakeholders or sites. The ideal candidate brings a proactive, customer-focused approach and the ability to support large retrofit and modernization projects in a fast-paced Services environment.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must satisfactorily perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.

Ability to build and maintain business relationships with customers meet deadlines and deliver customer service excellence.
Calm, polite, and professional demeanor with high service orientation, initiative, and drive.
Experience with the principles and methods for initiating, planning, scheduling, executing, controlling, and closing out projects.
Exceptional time management, negotiation, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
Excels at problem-solving, communication, and decision-making in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.
Outstanding planning and organization skills to build and manage complex project schedules independently.
Ability to work in a high-pressure environment, balance shifting priorities, adapt to changes in work setting, and make good business judgements, balancing the best interests of both company & customer.
Capable of multitasking in a fast-paced work environment while appropriately prioritizing activities.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and influence both credibly and effectively at all organizational levels.
Aptitude for learning new products, systems, and processes quickly.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial reports, technical documents, and legal documents.
Embraces a culture of continuous innovation and demonstrates a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies, including the integration of artificial intelligence tools into everyday workflows and processes as the company continues to evolve its digital capabilities.
Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.
Committed to continuous education through self-learning, training, workshops, seminars, and conferences.
Proficient in Microsoft Project/Planner, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Teams, as well as Salesforce, Primavera P6, or SAP.

Education And/Or Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration/Management, Project Management, or a related field preferred but not required. Equivalent project management, technical, or industry experience will be considered. PMP certification preferred.
4-7 years of project management experience managing customer-facing projects with responsibility for budgets, schedules, financial performance, documentation, and cross-functional team coordination.
Experience managing large retrofit projects, multi-site customer projects, material handling systems, automation, controls, industrial equipment, or system integration projects preferred.
Proven experience in budgeting, planning, financial management, supplier/vendor coordination, change management, risk management, and execution of moderate to large projects.
Knowledge of project management methodologies including PMI/PMBOK, CPM, Agile, Scrum, PRINCE2, Waterfall, or Lean, with the ability to apply the appropriate methodology based on project needs.

TRAVEL

This position requires moderate business travel by airplane, personal/rental car, and public transportation both domestically and internationally. The ability to secure a rental car and pay for all reimbursable travel expenses is essential. The candidate must be willing to travel as required and be capable of completing international travel of 10 or more hours. Overnight travel is approximately 25% and may increase during periods of active project execution, customer site support, and multi-site retrofit implementations.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position is primarily office-based but requires regular interaction with customer sites, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, distribution centers, and active project locations. The Project Manager routinely collaborates with customers, subcontractors, field personnel, and internal stakeholders in both virtual and in-person settings.

Site visits may require exposure to moving mechanical equipment, elevated noise levels, varying weather conditions, and non-climate-controlled environments. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hard hats, hearing protection, high-visibility clothing, and safety footwear, may be required when visiting operational facilities or project sites.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to operate a computer and other office equipment, communicate verbally, and move throughout office and project environments.

The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and occasionally bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, climb stairs, or navigate active customer facilities and construction environments. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus while reviewing project documentation, schedules, drawings, and field conditions.

You've project-managed five similar rollouts. The first took four months, the second took three, the fifth took six weeks — and you can prove it. About The Job Project Manager - Early Childhood Education

Job Title:
Project Manager

Team:
Early Childhood Education (ECE)

Reports to :
Project Lead, ECE

Location:
New Delhi (with ~30–40% travel to states)

Experience Range:
2–4 years

About Central Square Foundation

Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working on the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We are driven by our mission to transform the school education system with a focus on improving children's learning outcomes, especially in low-income communities.

Learn more at the website.

About The Position

Early Childhood Education (ECE) refers to the pre-primary years, between the ages of 3 and 6, before a child enters Grade 1. Research across economics, neuroscience and education has shown that 90% of brain development happens before the age of 5, and that the quality of these years shapes a child’s schooling, health and income for life. The National Education Policy 2020 calls for three years of pre-primary education for every child.

CSF partners with state governments and academic bodies to support the institutionalisation of developmentally appropriate pre-primary education within government school systems through curriculum, teacher preparation, classroom resources and implementation support.

We work at scale in states including Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, and Telangana, and our work aims to create evidence and implementation playbooks to make quality pre-primary a regular part of the school system everywhere.

The Project Manager supports the Project Lead across the ECE workstream and owns defined pieces of work within it. The role offers early exposure to the full spectrum of the work, from policy-level engagement to what actually happens in classrooms, and involves working with state teams, partner organisations, government counterparts, and CSF’s research and fundraising teams.

Key Responsibilities

Review on-ground implementation: Spend regular time in schools, teacher trainings, district meeting and reviews to assess how pre-primary classes are being set up and run against the programme design. Document what is working, what is not, and why.
Create and improve the playbooks: Turn field learning into playbooks, setup guidelines and resource packages that a state can adopt, and keep them current as states adapt them.
Run diagnostics and handhold states: Design and run diagnostic tools for states setting up pre-primary classes, and provide hands-on support to state teams and officials through rollout.
Build the evidence base: Maintain structured field notes, case studies and implementation data that feed the research team, policy notes and funder proposals, and support pilots and studies on the ground.
Coordinate partners and state teams: Run the day-to-day working rhythm with partner organisations and CSF’s state teams, including joint workplans, reviews and follow-through.
Manage delivery: Own workplans and trackers for central ECE workstreams, manage consultants and vendors, and flag risks to ensure high quality delivery

Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities

Relevant Experience (2–4 years) - Two to four years of strong performance in public policy, consulting, education or development, including through a structured fellowship. A Master’s in Education, Public Policy, Social Sciences or Management preferred.
Synthesis and Communication - The ability to turn research, field observation and stakeholder input into clear, well-structured written drafts and presentations
Fluency in English and Hindi - Both spoken and written, at a standard that supports drafting for government audiences and working with state teams.
Exposure to Government - Some experience of working with government officials or department processes, through a fellowship, a PMU or a government-facing role will be an advantage
Execution Discipline - A record of running workplans, tracking several pieces of work at once and coordinating people without losing detail.
A Hands-On Temperament - Suited to a small organisation with shifting priorities and frequent travel, and comfortable operating without a settled plan.

Candidates with prior experience of teaching young children are encouraged to apply.

Location/Schedule:

Cascadia Mission and Vision

Mission
: Cascadia Health delivers whole health care – integrated mental health and addiction services, primary care, and housing – to promote hope and support the well-being of the communities we serve.

Vision
: We envision a community where everyone benefits from whole health care, experiences well-being, and has a self-directed, connected life.

Program Description
: Cascadia operates three secure residential homes in the Portland Metro area. These are homes for adults who experience severe and persistent mental health challenges. Employees work as a team to provide comprehensive services that focus on psychiatric treatment, personal care, skills training, and case management. Our residents are referred from the counties or the state and must either be under commitment or have a guardian. The focus of treatment is on immediate safety and preparing individuals to live in a less restrictive environment. Our work is important, impactful, and rewarding to those we are lucky enough to serve. Sites include Faulkner Place, Arbor Place, and Barbara Roberts House.

Position description:
The Program Manager III is responsible for the comprehensive management and oversight of assigned residential treatment programs. This role ensures the delivery of high-quality clinical and medical services in alignment with organizational goals and regulatory standards. The Program Manager III leads a team of dedicated staff, providing supervision, training, and evaluation to maintain the highest standards of resident care. Key responsibilities include monitoring program effectiveness, managing financial operations, ensuring compliance with licensing requirements, and fostering a safe, therapeutic environment. This position requires strong leadership skills, the ability to manage crisis situations, and a commitment to continuous improvement in service delivery. The Program Manager III also serves as a liaison with community partners, stakeholders, and referral sources, ensuring smooth operations and positive outcomes for residents.

Essential Responsibilities

This position description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, or working conditions associated with the position. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

Manage and oversee daily operations of assigned residential treatment program(s), ensuring the delivery of high-quality clinical and medical services in alignment with organizational goals and standards.
Monitor program effectiveness by evaluating and implementing changes that enhance service delivery, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, while maintaining compliance with relevant regulations and internal policies.
Develop and maintain program goals in collaboration with leadership, integrating best practices and evaluating the effectiveness of services provided.
Supervise, train, and evaluate program staff, including determining staffing needs, hiring, and conducting performance reviews. Ensure staff competency in all areas, including medication management, crisis intervention, and resident care.
Provide leadership in crisis situations, coordinating with the treatment team to develop trauma-informed interventions and maintain a safe environment for residents and staff.
Ensure compliance with licensing and regulatory standards, including preparation for inspections and maintaining all aspects of the facility according to applicable guidelines.
Oversee financial management, including budgeting, tracking expenses, and ensuring compliance with fiscal policies.
Process program referrals, conduct screenings, and facilitate client move-ins while maintaining positive relationships with community partners and stakeholders.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation in electronic health records (EHR) and ensure compliance with all agency policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.
Ensure the cleanliness, safety, and maintenance of the facility, including adherence to fire safety protocols and evacuation procedures.
Support and oversee the delivery of therapeutic services, including developing curriculum, scheduling activities, and ensuring staff productivity and quality of care.
Handle client money management, oversee medication management services, and ensure proper documentation and training in these areas.
Participate in all scheduled meetings, training, and continuing education to stay informed and develop professional skills.
Perform other duties as assigned to support the overall success of the residential program.

Qualifications

Education
: Bachelor’s degree in a behavioral science field from an accredited college or university or three years of full-time professional experience providing direct service to individuals in a social service setting. Demonstrate the competencies to become credentialed as a Qualified Mental Health Associate (QMHA), as outlined in the Oregon Administrative Rulings (OARs). Certification must be kept current and in compliance with OARs through MHACBO.

Experience

Five years of clinical experience providing outpatient or inpatient services in a mental health or social service setting is required.
Two years of supervisory experience is preferred.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
Basic knowledge of Trauma Informed Care (TIC), Motivational Interviewing, and Evidence-Based Practices.
Basic understanding of recovery models, illness management, and strength-based philosophies.
Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Word & Excel).
CPR Certification (training provided post-hire).

Other
: Possess a valid driver’s license, minimum of one year driving history, ability to pass Driver Motor Vehicle (DMV) check and complete the Cascadia online Defensive Driving course (some programs).

Working Conditions

Environmental: Work is generally performed in a residential treatment home and occasionally in the community. Universal precautions should be taken due to exposure to disease, biohazards, noise, and contaminants.
Operating Hours: The general working hours for this position is business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Due to the nature of residential/direct service work, the Program Manager is required to be flexible to meet program(s) need, including covering open shifts as needed to meet staffing ratios which may include occasionally working swing and overnight shifts. The Program Manager is also required to participate in an on-call rotation and provide response to the program(s) in the event of a crisis or emergency. Schedules may vary depending on program.
Mental: Meal periods and breaks may be interrupted. Constant awareness and alertness are critical to detect and address escalated, potentially volatile situations.
Physical Demands: Requires constant alertness, perception, and awareness of surroundings. Regularly stationary work at a computer, moving around program spaces, assisting residents with daily living tasks, cleaning, and using a computer for documentation. Requires occasional lifting of 20 to 50 lbs. (e.g., supplies). Requires occasional fast movement in potentially escalated situations to evade harm.

Cascadia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, contact us at 503-963-7654.

Employees are responsible for obtaining and maintaining all licenses, certifications, registrations, and other credentials required for their position. Required credentials must remain active and in good standing as a condition of employment. Candidates are encouraged to familiarize themselves with any applicable credentialing requirements, including associated fees and renewal or maintenance obligations, prior to applying.

Benefits

jobs.location: Millers Point, New South Wales, Australia
jobs.description:
About Us

Calling all experience creators!

Let’s go to the pub!” Chances are, it’s one of ours. The cornerstone of over 350 Australian communities, ALH owns and operates more pubs than anyone. In every community, the pub is where stories are made and retold. A place to escape, and feel at home. With passion on tap, our team adds to every pub’s story. A great local is made up of great people. And together, both sides of the bar create something special.

About The Role

Everyone’s welcome, come as you are
Deliver demand-based workforce planning across Australia's largest hospitality network
Sydney or Melbourne based

As the Senior Data Analyst - Workforce Planning
, you'll be a core member of our Business Excellence (BEX) team and operational transformation, providing analytical firepower to move our pub operations toward predictive, demand-driven workforce planning and broader workforce planning analysis.

You will be critical in delivering smarter, demand-based Workforce Planning, creating the models that link demand to optimised staffing, and will own data-analytics for Advanced Workforce Planning Discovery, ensuring we build the right capabilities and tooling for advanced enterprise rostering.

Your work will directly enable our +350 Venue Manager to schedule the 'right team at the right time,' balancing sales maximisation and cost-efficiency - with team and guest experience.

Sound good? Read on.

Here is a taster of what you can expect in this role:

Productivity Opportunity Ideation

Perform deep-dive diagnostics on historic sales and labour performance to identify and quantify efficiency gaps through advanced statistical analysis of labour productivity across suitable venue segmentation.
Execute independent data exploration to uncover untapped optimisation opportunities beyond standard reporting; proactively partner with BEX team members to turn hypotheses into actionable business cases.

Support Development of Demand-based Workforce Planning

Build and maintain venue segmentation frameworks and labour productivity benchmarks. Develop 'by driver' demand-forecasting models that translate complex sales drivers into granular required labour hours.

Provide Analytical Support for Advanced Workforce Planning Tooling Discovery

Play a key supporting role in the discovery phase for advanced workforce planning tooling, working in close collaboration with the dedicated Project Team and business Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
Assist with necessary labour modelling and analysis, and provide data access to inform the development of suggestions for future-state workforce planning solutions.

Insight Communication

Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable 'so-what' insights for Publicans and Area Managers, fostering a culture of data-led decision-making.

Visibility & Tracking

Support Finance in estimating and tracking benefit metrics post-implementation (economic and process) to report progress to executive sponsors and ensure sustainable value capture.

What do we need from you

Now Let’s Talk About You

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Economics, or related quantitative field.
Have a minimum of 5 years hands on experience.
Experience in workforce management and familiarity with enterprise scheduling software (e.g., UKG), ideally related to demand-based rostering and/or labour models.
Proficiency in Cloud platforms (GCP, DBT), strong SQL skills and data visualisation (Tableau).
Experience in building predictive forecasting models and applying advanced analytics (incl. AI).
Ability to frame and solve open-ended, complex problems, ask the right questions, and connect analytical results to practical change.
Ability to travel to venues to understand operational 'floor reality'.
Experience in hospitality sector operations will be highly regarded.

The benefits are good too!

An exclusive discount card for our ALH Hotels pubs & accommodation, BWS, Dan Murphy’s and other Endeavour Group brands. Through our partnership with Woolworths, you'll also enjoy discounts at Woolies supermarkets and BIG W
As a valued member of the team, your health and wellbeing is our top priority. You will have access to a range of free services to help you live well and support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
Endeavour Group is full of opportunities - use our dedicated learning and development options to grow an idea, yourself, and your career. This is just the start, so dream big
Find out more about our range of benefits and discounts here

At Endeavour, we value being a workplace where everyone’s welcome - if you meet a number of the requirements (and not all), we encourage you to apply.

What's in it for you?

We are together creators

We’re big, but part of something much bigger. ALH is in good company, sitting alongside the likes of Dan Murphy’s, BWS, Pinnacle Drinks within the Endeavour Group. Together we create the moments that bring millions of people together. And together we have more fun, create more opportunities, and score a lot more goals. We’re serious about having a good time - creating a safe, inclusive and fun place to rock up to. We’re all about creating a more sociable future, together - for our customers and each other.

#WeAreTogetherCreators #ComeAsYouAre #DreamBig #FeelTheEnergy #LeaveYourMark #ALH #EndeavourGroup

You can learn more about working with us on LinkedIn or at endeavourgroupcareers.com.au

Our Talent Team and Hiring Leaders kindly request no unsolicited resumes or approaches from Recruitment Agencies. Endeavour Group is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Employment Type: Full Time, Fixed Term 2-year opportunity.
Remuneration: Level 8: from $132,445+ 17% superannuation and leave loading

About UNSW

At UNSW, we pride ourselves on being a workplace where the best people come to do their best work. We aspire to be Australia’s global university, improving and transforming lives through excellence in research, outstanding education and a commitment to advancing a just society.

About The Role

The Senior Program Analyst will play a key role in the successful delivery of the Business Optimisation Strategy (BOS).

The Senior Program Analyst supports the PMO function for the BOS program by providing integrated reporting, data analysis, and governance insights across all workstreams. The role provides and supports the PMO’s single source of truth for program performance, enabling informed decision-making through a consolidated view of program health and detailed analysis of workstream-level performance across schedule, risks, resources, and financials.

The Senior Program Analyst will report to the Senior PMO Lead and has no direct reports. While allocated to the program, the Senior Program Analyst will liaise heavily with the Program Managers for daily work allocations.

Responsibilities

Lead the consolidation and analysis of data across all BOS workstreams to deliver integrated reporting on schedules, risks, dependencies, resources, and financials.
Maintain program-wide governance artefacts, including risks, issues, actions, and decisions, ensuring they are traceable, up to date, and aligned with PMO standards.
Support integrated planning by monitoring milestones, critical path activities, and cross-stream dependencies to identify risks and recommend corrective actions.
Maintain data integrity and consistency across all reporting tools and outputs, upholding the PMO as the single source of truth.
Prepare high-quality reporting packs, insights, and analysis for SteerCo, PMG, and other governance forums to drive informed decision-making.
Evaluate program performance data to identify trends, variances, and emerging risks, escalating critical matters and advising leadership on strategic adjustments.
Translate complex program, project, and financial data into clear, actionable insights for key stakeholders at all levels.
Coordinate cross-workstream PMO operations to ensure alignment across delivery activities, governance processes, and reporting cadences.

About You

Tertiary qualifications or equivalent substantial experience, paired with a practical understanding of modern project management methodologies in fast-paced program environments.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI to build dynamic dashboards, standardise governance reporting, and deliver ad hoc analysis for senior stakeholder forums.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with high attention to detail in policy interpretation and complex data analysis.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to build strong stakeholder relationships, influence outcomes, and translate complex insights clearly.
Demonstrated initiative and ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively, with a commitment to alignment with organizational values, policies, and objectives.

For further information on the role & responsibilities, please refer to the Position Description.

About The Role

The Project Manager is accountable for the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional business and technology initiatives within a fast-paced Insurtech environment. This position leads projects from planning through implementation, transition, and closeout, ensuring that intended business outcomes are achieved within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk parameters.

The Project Manager provides structure and leadership across multidisciplinary teams that may include insurance operations, underwriting, product, technology, data, finance, compliance, legal, and external partners. This individual is accountable for planning, coordinating, governing, and delivering projects including driving execution, facilitating critical decisions, managing competing priorities, and maintaining accountability across all levels of the project.

Successful candidates will combine disciplined project management expertise with business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to lead through influence in an evolving, technology-enabled insurance organization.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

Lead complex business, operational, product, and technology projects from initiation through implementation and closeout.
Establish the project governance and delivery structure, scope, objectives, success measures, milestones, and implementation approach.
Translate strategic business objectives into actionable project plans with clearly defined deliverables, owners, dependencies, and timelines.
Assume accountability for overall project performance, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and business outcomes.
Drive project execution across cross-functional teams, ensuring that commitments are understood, monitored, and completed.
Maintain delivery momentum by identifying obstacles, resolving conflicts, and facilitating timely decisions.
Evaluate project performance and implement corrective actions when results deviate from approved plans.
Ensure projects transition successfully into ongoing business operations, with clear ownership and support models following implementation.

Scope, Schedule, and Budget Management

Define, validate, and manage project scope in partnership with executive sponsors, business owners, and key stakeholders.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans that account for business, operational, technical, vendor, and regulatory dependencies.
Establish realistic schedules based on project complexity, resource capacity, organizational priorities, and implementation requirements.
Develop, manage, and monitor project budgets, forecasts, vendor costs, and financial performance, as applicable.
Assess the impact of requested changes to scope, schedule, cost, resources, risk, and anticipated benefits.
Lead formal change-control processes and obtain appropriate stakeholder approval before implementing material changes.
Provide transparent reporting on project health, financial status, delivery risks, and forecasted outcomes.

Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management

Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies.
Develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans for risks that could affect delivery or business outcomes.
Evaluate the business impact and urgency of project issues and drive timely resolution with accountable owners.
Escalate significant decisions, risks, resource constraints, and delivery concerns to project sponsors and PMO leadership.
Monitor dependencies across projects, systems, business areas, vendors, and implementation workstreams.
Apply sound judgment to balance speed, quality, cost, risk, and business value when recommending a course of action.
Maintain clear decision, risk, issue, and change records throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder and Executive Management

Serve as the primary delivery leader and central point of accountability for assigned projects.
Establish productive working relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, subject matter experts, technology teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
Clarify roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and stakeholder expectations at the beginning of each project.
Provide concise, decision-oriented updates to executives, steering committees, and governance groups.
Present project recommendations, alternatives, tradeoffs, risks, and business impacts in a clear and actionable manner.
Facilitate alignment when stakeholders have competing goals, priorities, or perspectives.
Build consensus and secure decisions necessary to maintain project progress.
Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle and communicate changes proactively.

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Lead multidisciplinary project teams across insurance operations, underwriting, product, technology, data, finance, legal, compliance, and other business functions.
Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and results within the project team.
Define project roles and responsibilities and ensure team members understand their commitments.
Partner with functional leaders to secure qualified project resources and address competing capacity demands.
Facilitate effective collaboration between business and technology teams.
Hold workstream leaders and project contributors accountable for agreed deliverables and deadlines.
Support productive conflict resolution and remove barriers that could affect team performance or delivery.
Provide project direction without relying on formal supervisory authority.

Technology and Insurtech Delivery

Lead initiatives involving insurance platforms, digital products, workflow automation, systems integration, data solutions, operational transformation, or customer-facing technology.
Partner with product, engineering, data, quality assurance, information security, and business teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Coordinate business and technical workstreams to ensure requirements, solution design, testing, implementation, and operational readiness remain aligned.
Ensure that business requirements and expected outcomes are understood and traceable throughout project delivery.
Manage project activities across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models based on the needs of the initiative.
Coordinate release planning, testing readiness, deployment activities, implementation support, and post-launch stabilization.
Work with appropriate partners to ensure projects consider security, privacy, compliance, data integrity, and operational-resilience requirements.
Support the successful integration of third-party platforms and external technology partners.

Insurance Operations and Regulatory Alignment

Develop an understanding of the insurance processes, products, controls, and operating models affected by each project.
Partner with underwriting, operations, claims, finance, actuarial, compliance, legal, and technology stakeholders as required by the initiative.
Ensure relevant regulatory, contractual, audit, security, and compliance considerations are incorporated into project plans.
Identify operational impacts resulting from changes to systems, workflows, products, data, or business processes.
Coordinate with control functions to obtain required reviews, approvals, and documentation.
Promote solutions that improve scalability, data quality, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
Ensure project teams appropriately document material decisions, requirements, controls, and approvals.

Vendor and Partner Management

Manage project activities involving software providers, consultants, implementation partners, and other third parties.
Integrate vendor plans, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables into the overall project plan.
Monitor vendor performance against contractual commitments, project requirements, delivery dates, and quality expectations.
Facilitate resolution of vendor-related risks, delivery gaps, and dependency issues.
Partner with procurement, legal, information security, finance, and business owners throughout vendor selection and implementation activities.
Review vendor recommendations and challenge assumptions when necessary to protect project objectives.
Escalate material vendor performance concerns and support the development of corrective-action plans.

Change Management and Business Readiness

Assess how project outcomes will affect employees, customers, partners, workflows, systems, controls, and organizational responsibilities.
Integrate change management, communication, training, adoption, and business-readiness activities into the overall delivery plan.
Partner with business leaders and change management resources to identify impacted stakeholder groups and adoption risks.
Ensure impacted teams are prepared to operate new processes, systems, products, or capabilities before implementation.
Establish implementation-readiness criteria and facilitate go-live decisions with project sponsors and operational owners.
Monitor adoption, stabilization, and early performance following implementation.
Ensure ownership is formally transitioned to the appropriate business and operational teams.

Governance and Performance Reporting

Establish project governance that supports effective oversight, timely decisions, and clear accountability.
Lead steering committee meetings, executive reviews, project working sessions, and delivery checkpoints.
Develop accurate project status reports, executive presentations, dashboards, forecasts, and decision materials.
Provide objective assessments of project health rather than relying solely on completed activities or reported progress.
Monitor delivery performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and benefit expectations.
Ensure project records and approvals meet PMO governance and documentation requirements.
Conduct project closeout reviews and capture lessons learned, delivery insights, and improvement opportunities.
Contribute to the continued development of PMO standards, methodologies, governance practices, and portfolio reporting.

Required Qualifications

Five or more years of project management experience, including direct accountability for complex, cross-functional initiatives.

We're powering a cleaner, brighter future.

Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient.

We're powered by purpose-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10.7 million customers at six energy companies -- Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power & Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco).

We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive.

In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career.

Are you in?

Primary Purpose

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION

Develop, manage, and evaluate key projects programs initiatives, primarily surrounding battery energy storage systems, aggregators, and virtual power plant programs, from planning to post implementation phases as required. Develop business plans, project charters, and performance metrics in support of business objectives. Ensure organizational alignment with management models and principles and drive the integration of best practices. Perform various assignments including requests for financial and operational reports, data analysis and modeling, business planning, and or performance measurement. Coordinate quality assurance and or change management activities with internal and external personnel. Position may be required to work extended hours for coverage during storms or other energy delivery emergencies.

Primary Duties

PRIMARY DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

Lead development, implementation, and evaluation of projects, programs, and/or business initiatives. Provide requirements analysis, performance measurement, and quality assurance. Manage scope, schedule, and budget for organizational projects and programs. (20%)
Coordinate and report on process/project/initiative assignments. Develop performance indicators and tracking mechanisms to monitor and report results. Prepare, review, and analyze reports, controls, and other financial & operational information for specific projects and initiatives. (20%)
Coordinate work plans to implement corrective actions that are identified as a result of performance assessment. (10%)
Support the establishment of business plans and objectives across multiple areas / departments. Coordinate with stakeholders on the development of business cases and prioritization of deliverables. (10%)
Lead change management activities for projects, programs, and initiatives. Develop and implement training of employees and external personnel for new processes and procedures. Develop and implement effective business readiness procedures. (10%)
Participate in process improvement task forces. Provide benchmarking analysis. Prepare status reports to leadership. (10%)
Understand business processes and provide guidance for end users. Provide day-to-day client support and conduct diagnostics as necessary to ensure optimal performance. Assist and advise other personnel with responses to internal and external inquiries. (20%)

JOB SCOPE

This is an individual contributor position that works independently with only general direction, relying on knowledge skills and judgment acquired through education and relevant experience to plan and accomplish assigned tasks and goals. The position regularly mentors less experienced colleagues.
Direct Reports = 0

Drives the development of key projects/programs/initiatives to ensure complete and successful implementation. Develops and tracks key milestones.
